war_summary: War 139 is on day 86 with no winner yet. The map is heavily polarized: Colonials hold 140 strategic bases across 27 regions, Wardens hold 68 across 10 regions, and no bases are neutral. Combat is concentrated in a handful of contested regions. Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, Oarbreaker, Mooring County, Endless Shore, and Onyx show recent ownership flips (captures and owner-losses) and elevated casualties. Clahstra and Stlican Shelf have the highest 24h event counts (21 and 25) with multiple bases seeing repeated captures. Oarbreaker saw 7 events in the last 2h and 22 in 24h, including bases turning neutral. Mooring County and Endless Shore also have multi-base churn. Olavis Wake and Speaking Woods have high casualty rates but fewer recent flips. Most other regions are quiet with zero 24h events and one-sided ownership.
